scope: Adaptive follow-up after H1ax on the same32 H1ap streams: fixed first750/900/1000 observations. Archived600 H1ax and1110 H1aw proofs and controls reverified without refitting. No new queries, acquisition or latent draws; no fresh-source confirmation.
supplied_prior: Exactly 20 incident retained edges per cell, implying exactly 810 undirected edges. The top810 control receives that cardinality directly. These are explicit structural priors; no prior-free or uniqueness claim.
cost: Integer round-half-even(1000000*(c+1)/(m+2)). Exact integer quotient/remainder producer; independent Fraction rounding auditor. Laplace-smoothed empirical equality rate; no supplied q0 or q1, no tuning. Unexposed pair cost500000.
objective: All3240 unordered pairs eligible; minimize sum(cost*x) with 0<=x<=1 and degree20 at every cell. No row/column/box geometry in construction.
tie_convention: Top810 sorts (integer cost, lexicographic unordered pair index). LP uses deterministic column pair-index order and frozen HiGHS dual simplex seed/options. No lexicographic objective perturbation or uniqueness claim.
certificate: No primal rounding/snapping. Literal primal values must belong to {0,0.5,1}. Multiply by two exactly; require exact degree40. Reconstruct node dual y2=round-to-nearest-even(2*y_float), requiring absolute reconstruction error<=1e-6. Set upper dual z2=min(0,2*w-y2_i-y2_j). Check integer dual feasibility, both complementarity conditions and exact equality sum(w*x2)=20*sum(y2)+sum(z2). Costs and duals restricted to absolute value<2^48. No alternate denominators or fallback scheme.
certificate_rationale: Unsigned graph incidence LPs with integral costs and degree RHS admit half-integral basic primal/dual witnesses via tree/odd-cycle components. The fixed scale-two reconstruction is a practical scheme, not an assumption that every solver output is certifiable. Acceptance rests only on exact integer checks. No uniqueness conclusion follows.
outcome_rules: Certified integral exact => success; certified integral nonexact or certified fractional => resolved failure of this procedure; numerical/time/nonrepresentable/certification gaps => unresolved. No primal rounding or fallback denominator. No uniqueness claim.
primary: N900: >=29/32 independently certified integral exact graphs. Supported if successes>=29; falsified only if successes+unresolved<29; otherwise inconclusive. N750/N1000 and top810 controls descriptive; all32 retained at each prefix.
leakage: Eager-load only given/values arrays once perbank. Feature builder cumulatively reads rows0..999 and copies independent snapshots at750/900/1000. Each LP receives only its snapshot costs, all3240 candidates and fixed degree20. No final supports, later observations, future-derived costs, warm starts or later-prefix outputs enter earlier fits. Archived600/1110 models are loaded only after new fits. Independent pair-vector recount plus future-suffix substitution for each prefix must leave counts/costs unchanged.
predictability: H1ap current masks were finalized before current labels. Reused prefix masks remain predictable. Their acquisition used the historical calibration; this is not end-to-end calibration-free acquisition, only q0/q1-free recovery costs.
interpretation: Finite budget-prefix mechanism on nested already-seen streams. Prefixes are dependent, not independent replications; shorter labels are literal subsets. No multiple-prefix primary, fresh-source or universal-noise claim.

budget.scope: Preparation, three fits perbank, independent recount/suffix gates/certificates, archived proof checks and summary. Each actualLP time_limit1s; eight one-thread workers. Synthetic preflight and packaging separate.

query_scope: Nested historical observations; prefix totals are alternative budgets, not additive new query spend. Shared calibration charged once perbank per hypothetical truncated acquisition. No new queries/source rows/solver puzzle inputs.
